senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; קָצַץ)end, term, designated time, esp. the time of redemption.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:7">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 41:5">Is. XLI, 5</cite>) <he>זה שרוי בקִיצּוֹ של עולם וכ׳</he> this one (Abraham) dwelt in one extreme part of the world, and that one (Shem) in the other &c.
<cite ref="Nedarim 41a:7">Ned. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>כיון שהגיע קיצו וכ׳</he> when a man’s time (to die) has come.
<cite ref="Megillah 3a:6">Meg. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>משום דאית ביה קץ משיח</he> because therein (in the Hagiographa) are contained intimations about the Messianic term (the Book of Daniel).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 92b:6">Snh. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>שמנו לקץ וטעו</he> who ventured calculations as to the time of the redemption from Egypt, and made a mistake; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20">Ex. R. s. 20</cite> <he>יצאו … שלם הקץ</he> they left Egypt before the predestined term had expired; a. fr.—Pl. <he>קִצִּים</he>, <cite ref="S01814"><he>קִצִּין</he></cite>, <cite ref="S00089"><he>קִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 61b:4">Ab. Zar. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>ממונה הבא לק׳</he> a superintendent that comes at regular times.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 97b:9">Ib.</cite> <he>כלו כל הק׳ ואין וכ׳</he> all the dates of redemption (calculated from the Scriptures) have passed, and the thing depends only on repentance.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:8:1">Cant. R. to II, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00491"><he>עִיבּוּר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01764"><he>קִפַץ</he></cite>; a. fr.—[<he>קיצין</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:11">Cant. R. to V, 11</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01115"><he>קִיץ</he></cite>.]
